title: The Courier’s Rendezvous
story: The courier has left six cards and a note: “I cannot name our meeting place openly. Put the cards in the order described by the clues, then read the first letter of each card’s label from left to right. Enter the place you discover.” The cards have been shuffled.
hints: Three clues join cards into pairs. Keep each pair together and preserve its internal order.
The two remaining clues tell you how to order the three pairs.
Once every clue fits, read only the first letter of each label, from left to right. A label with several words still contributes just one letter.
